findings.title: UI bundle switched from i18next `{{n}}` to Java `{n}` and `{2,choice,...}`; the placeholders will render literally
findings.body: Every other parameterised key in this file uses i18next syntax (`'{{0}}'`, `{{1}}`, e.g. lines 14, 27, 140). The account UI loads this bundle through i18next with default interpolation (`js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-29`, no ICU plugin). The server error path calls `t(key, {0:…,1:…,2:…})` in `js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86`. i18next only interpolates `{{…}}`, so the new `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and the `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` are not substituted. The user would see the raw template for a multivalued size error. `{choice}` is a Java `MessageFormat` feature that i18next does not support. The verifier does not need this change: its comment at VerifyMessageProperties.java:96 says the sanitizer's `<!-- -->` insertion for double curly braces is already handled. Restore the `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` form here. If pluralisation is wanted, use i18next's plural mechanism, not `choice`. The same applies to the admin-ui file.

findings.title: Admin UI bundle: `{0}`/`{2,choice,…}` will not be interpolated by i18next
findings.body: The admin UI uses i18next with default `{{…}}` interpolation (`js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-18`). Server validation errors are translated with `t(errorMessage, {0:…,1:…,2:…})` in `js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86`. The 25 neighbouring keys in this file use `{{0}}`. With `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,…}` the admin console shows the unsubstituted template instead of the attribute name and bounds. Revert this line to the `{{n}}` syntax (and the `value(s)` wording, or an i18next plural). The Java-style `choice` change belongs only in `themes/.../base/*/messages_en.properties`, where the server formats it with `MessageFormat` and the parameters are `Long`s (MultiValueValidator.java:136-137).

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP step 1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian bundle is now `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users see an Italian sentence on the OTP setup page, and nothing flags it. The English source is `Install one of the following applications on your mobile:` (themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/login/messages/messages_en.properties:128). Provide a Lithuanian translation. Or drop the key so it falls back to English, rather than shipping the wrong language.

findings.title: Lithuanian account TOTP step 1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `totpStep1` now reads `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` (Italian) in the Lithuanian account bundle. The previous value was a correct Lithuanian string; it only needed its anchors removed. Use a Lithuanian translation, or remove the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle receives Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: `totpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). This is the zh_CN bundle. The login zh_CN counterpart (`messages_zh_CN.properties:123`) uses Simplified (`在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`). It looks copied from zh_TW. Use Simplified text, e.g. `在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：`.

findings.title: Missing English counterpart aborts the build with an unwrapped RuntimeException
findings.body: The English file path is derived by regex from the absolute path (lines 74-75), and an `IOException` becomes a bare `RuntimeException` (line 79). `verify()` and `ThemeVerifierMojo` only handle `MojoExecutionException`. Any `messages_xx.properties` without a sibling `messages_en.properties` (a new theme folder, or a file whose name does not match the regex) gives a stack trace instead of a readable validation message. `replaceAll("resources-community", "resources")` also rewrites the whole absolute path, so a checkout directory containing that string would break the lookup. Wrap the failure in `MojoExecutionException`, or report a message such as `no English source for <file>`.

findings.title: New dependency versions are hard-coded in a standalone pom
findings.body: `owasp-java-html-sanitizer` 20240325.1 and `commons-text` 1.13.0 are pinned here. This pom has no parent, so they are not covered by the root dependency management or its update tooling. `<scope>compile</scope>` on commons-text is the default and can be dropped. Consider a version property next to `maven-plugin-api.version`, so the pins are easy to find and bump.

contracts.action: Server-side validation message `error-invalid-multivalued-size` reworded to use `{2,choice,…}` and shown in the account UI and admin UI
contracts.equivalent_path: Other validation messages in the same bundle (e.g. error-invalid-length at line 140) use i18next `{{n}}` placeholders, interpolated via t(key, params) in js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86
contracts.before_after: Before: `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` were interpolated by i18next. After: `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` and a `choice` format, which i18next does not process.
contracts.visible_effect: The UI shows the raw template text instead of the attribute name and bounds.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent: no error is raised; the user just sees the unsubstituted message.

contracts.action: New verifySafeHtml step run for every messages_*.properties during the verify-theme goal (INSTALL phase in themes and js poms)
contracts.equivalent_path: verifyNoDuplicateKeys, which reads the file contents and records messages; failures are collected and thrown as MojoFailureException by ThemeVerifierMojo
contracts.before_after: Before: only duplicate keys were checked. After: each translation is also compared against its English sibling and sanitised; a missing English file throws a RuntimeException.
contracts.visible_effect: Maven build fails with 'Validation errors' for any translation that has HTML not in the English source, or any anchor not in English. A missing English file gives a raw stack trace.
contracts.failure_mode: Build-time only; an unreadable English file produces an unwrapped RuntimeException.

summary:
Verifier logic and its tests look consistent. Four things need fixing:

- **UI bundle regression.** The account-ui and admin-ui `error-invalid-multivalued-size` messages were changed from i18next `{{n}}` to Java `{n}` with `{2,choice,…}`. The UI uses i18next with default interpolation, so the placeholders will show up literally. The verifier does not require this change, so these two lines should be reverted. I did not run the UI, so this rests on the i18next config and `utils.ts`; confidence is medium.
- **Wrong-language translations.** The Lithuanian account and login `totpStep1` strings were replaced with Italian. The zh_CN account string is Traditional Chinese.
- **Missing English file.** A missing English sibling surfaces as an unwrapped `RuntimeException` rather than a validation message.
- **Pinned dependencies.** The two new dependencies are pinned with hard-coded versions in a standalone pom.
